description: The plot presents grouped bar counts for different “Type” categories across two models, illustrating how many instances fall into each category for GPT3.5 and Mistral 7B. The x-axis is labeled “Model” and uses a categorical scale with two tick labels, “GPT3.5” and “Mistral 7B.” The y-axis is labeled “Count” and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 120 with regularly spaced tick marks every 20 units (0, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100, 120). For each model, five adjacent bars are shown: Type1 is a teal/green bar, Type2 is an orange bar, Type3 is a muted bluish-gray bar, RR is a pink bar, and WW is a light green bar. For GPT3.5, the Type1 bar is at 15, Type2 is at 25, Type3 is at 0 (no visible height), RR is at 123, and WW is at 35. For Mistral 7B, the Type1 bar is at 29, Type2 is at 26, Type3 is at 0 (no visible height), RR is at 114, and WW is at 31.
